hostUrl.title: Host URL
hostUrl.description: Base URL of the Fineract / Mifos provider, including the API prefix (typically `/fineract-provider/api/v1`).

tenantId.title: Tenant ID
tenantId.description: Fineract is multi-tenant. Sent on every request as the `Fineract-Platform-TenantId` header.

username.title: Username
username.description: Fineract user with the permissions required for the operations the workflow will call.

password.title: Password
password.description: Password for the Fineract user. Sent via HTTP Basic auth.

accessToken.title: OAuth Access Token
accessToken.description: Optional. If your Fineract deployment is configured for OAuth2 (`fineract.security.basicauth.enabled=false`), use a bearer token instead of basic auth.
